content: APPROVE. Independent evidence: 3/3 evidence_retry tests pass in 3.55s (failed_job_schedules_retry_in_the_future, retry_succeeds_when_due_and_increments_attempt_count, max_attempts_leaves_row_permanently_failed). Build + clippy + fmt clean. Migration 21 adds last_attempt_at + next_attempt_at + partial index. Permanence via 'next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL' guard in the drain WHERE clause. Backoff: 2^min(attempt,11) * retry_base_secs, capped 24h, ±25% jitter via integer math. DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=8 spans ~5h. retry_delay is pure (5 unit tests under evidence::worker::retry).
